scenes.heading: INT. OLD HOUSE - CHAMBER - NIGHT

THE OLD MAN: frail pale blue filmed eye wide open then corpse

drags him to floor pulls heavy bed over him
muffled beats under bed many minutes then cease
pulls bed aside hand on heart no pulsation
